title: Valheim

burden.note: 10 players at most; a well-explored world needs more memory

description: Valheim dedicated server (Steam app 896660) - two UDP ports (game port and the next one for the Steam query). Its world, logs and admin lists live in a save folder next to the server, so backups include them. The join password must be at least 5 characters and must not be part of the server name. Valheim has no remote console: players can't be warned before a restart (updates wait until nobody is on), ServerDeck sees only who is on, and bans and admins are Steam IDs in bannedlist.txt / adminlist.txt (Configs), or an admin's F5 console in game. Stops use Ctrl+C, which saves the world. Crossplay (Xbox / Game Pass) is off - add -crossplay to its arguments in config.json to turn it on. About 2-4 GB of RAM.
